protocol.name: Lemmy-Hacker News content-matched cross-platform validation
protocol.exact_rule: one-to-one nearest-time posts sharing a canonical URL within 72 hours
protocol.semantic_rule: one-to-one title TF-IDF similarity at or above 0.72 within 72 hours, excluding exact-URL posts
protocol.structural_rule: reply-tree metrics require complete trees on both platforms
protocol.adaptation_rule: fit only pre-cutoff non-test Lemmy cascades; select bounded ranking, viewport, and depth parameters on historical validation cascades
protocol.reporting_rule: exact URL and semantic event results remain separate
